  "summary": "Ported the split_segments() backslash branch into objectui's .claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh, closing the measured fail-open: outside quotes a backslash escapes the next character, so an escaped \\\" opens no quoted region, but without the branch the pass read the \" as opening a region that never closed, went inert for every separator behind it, and collapsed the command into one segment whose head word was harmless. Source of the shape was objectstack PR #11278's diff, cross-checked against objectui PR #6046's; #6046 has NOT landed on main (grep -c 11131 on main's guard-main-checkout-bash.sh returns 0), so nothing here depends on it. Only the objectstack#11131 half was ported -- the objectstack#11133 comment-heredoc half has no analogue because this hook has no strip_heredocs() pass. Two deliberate adaptations, both named in the PR body: upstream's trailing word=1 was dropped (this simpler split_segments() has no word flag and no unquoted-# comment rule), and the branch comment names check_segment()'s `read -r -a` instead of upstream's tokenize(), since that is the mechanism that makes keeping both characters verbatim correct here. The hook header's re-derivable self-test count line was updated 32/30 -> 41/39 so the file's own invariant stays true. Draft PR, left draft: .claude/** is governed surface and the body says a human merges it.",
  "tests": "All runs at 0835db154 (final commit, working tree clean; `git rev-parse --short HEAD` = 0835db154). (1) SELFTEST BEFORE/AFTER: `bash .claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh` -- before, at branch point 7c96c9420: verdict line `32 passed, 0 failed`; after: verdict line `41 passed, 0 failed` (39 expect lines + 2 inline specials). 41 = 32 + 9 new cases, so every pre-existing case still holds. (2) MEASURED PROBE, fed as the PreToolUse payload shape {tool_name:\"Bash\",tool_input:{command}} via the selftest's own verdict() shape: `git stash` (control) blocked BEFORE and blocked AFTER -- the guard was reached on both sides; `echo \\\" ; git stash` (the hole) ALLOWED before, blocked after. (3) DISCRIMINATION: all four new block cases run against the pre-fix hook (extracted with `git show HEAD:.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh` to a temp copy) were ALLOWED before and are blocked after -- `echo \\\" ; git stash`, `echo \\\" ; git stash pop`, `printf \\\" ; git stash drop`, and the newline-separated `echo \\\"` / `git stash pop`. So the new cases are not cases that already passed. (4) NO OVER-BLOCKING: every deliberately-allowed form measured ALLOWED after the change -- `git stash list`, `git stash show -p`, `git stash create`, `git stash --help`, `git stash apply abc1234`, `git stash apply --index deadbeefcafe1234`, `git stash store -m \"WIP issue-3430\" b52e3aa1234567`; plus the five new precision twins, all ALLOWED before AND after: `echo \\\" ; echo hello`, `echo \\\" ; cat README.md`, `echo a\\ b`, `echo \\\\ ; grep -n worktree README.md`, `echo \\\" ; git stash list`. (5) GATE UNION at 0835db154, each verdict line quoted from the gate's own output: `bash .claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh` -> `41 passed, 0 failed`; `bash .claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.selftest.sh` (untouched sibling, proving it was not modified) -> `100 passed, 0 failed`; `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` -> `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 5036 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` exit 0; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` -> `No source of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` exit 0; `bash -n` on both changed files -> syntax OK. Control-byte self-scan beyond the gate: `grep -naP '[\\x00-\\x08\\x0b\\x0c\\x0e-\\x1f\\x7f]'` over both changed files and over the PR body returned rc=1 (no match). Gate derivation: objectui has no scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs (that script lives in objectstack and answers only about its own tree), so the list was derived by hand from this repo's .github/workflows/ -- hook-selftests.yml (fires on .claude/hooks/**, runs both matrices), control-bytes.yml (unfiltered), changeset-guard.yml/changeset-presence. eslint here is scoped to **/*.{ts,tsx} and there is no shellcheck in the repo, so no lint reaches a .sh file -- narrowing declared, not silently taken. No changeset: only .claude/ changed, and check-changeset-presence.mjs confirms none is owed. CI convergence not awaited, per the standing dispatch contract.",

  ]
}
